question.prompt: While eating out, Mike and Joe each tipped their server \(\$2.\) Mike tipped \(10\%\) of his bill and Joe tipped \(20\%\) of his bill. What was the difference, in dollars, between their bills?

solutions.explanation:
Mike's \(10\%\) tip is \(\frac1{10}\) of his bill. His \(2\)-dollar tip is therefore one of ten equal parts of the bill, so his bill was \(10\cdot2=20\) dollars.

Joe's \(20\%\) tip is \(\frac15\) of his bill. His bill was therefore \(5\cdot2=10\) dollars.

The difference between their bills was \(20-10=10\) dollars, choice D.
